user.title: House Wi-Fi
user.description: UniFi or Cambium API (cnMaestro X) = auto codes. Without X: manual voucher (EasyPass by hand).

data_description.voucher_provider: UniFi = UDM. Cambium = cnMaestro X API. Manual = create the code in EasyPass and paste it here.

manual.title: Manual voucher
manual.description: No UniFi/Cambium API. Create codes in EasyPass (or elsewhere) and paste the current code below. You can change it later in Options.

data_description.manual_wifi_code: Current EasyPass code. Empty = Maison/mail show no code until you set one.

unifi.title: UniFi controller
unifi.description: Local UDM API key (Network, Integrations). Stored in the config entry; not logged or exported in diagnostics.

data_description.host: IP or hostname of the UDM Pro Max on the LAN.
data_description.api_key: Created in UniFi Network > Settings > Control Plane > Integrations, or at unifi.ui.com. Shown only once.
data_description.verify_ssl: Uncheck only for the factory self-signed certificate. The key then travels without server auth — LAN only.

cambium.title: Cambium EasyPass
cambium.description: No UniFi. cnMaestro Cloud API app + EasyPass portal + voucher plan. Names must match cnMaestro exactly.

data_description.cambium_voucher_plan: Exact plan name (duration and devices in cnMaestro).

site.title: UniFi site
site.description: Network site whose hotspot issues the vouchers.

house.title: House and guests
house.description: The calendar supplies the stays (title = guest name). The selected entities are the only ones the guest account can read and control.

data.confirm_sensitive: I allow cameras, locks or alarms

data_description.calendar_entity: Any calendar entity (Airbnb, Booking, Google or local ICS). Title = guest name. Put their email in the description for the J−2 mail.
data_description.lead_days: The Wi-Fi voucher, HA account and Maison link are issued this many days before arrival. Login and link become active on arrival day. Default: 3.
data_description.device_limit: Devices allowed to use the same code. Default: 10.
data_description.download_mbps: Converted to kbit/s for the API (100 Mbit/s = 100000 kbit/s). Default: 100.
data_description.extra_days: The Wi-Fi voucher stays this many days after the departure day, then it is deleted. Default: 1. The Maison link stops at the end of departure day.
data_description.access_mode: One account per stay, or a single guest account whose password rotates.
data_description.tenant_entities: Search and add entities (HA filter). Cameras, locks and alarms require the confirmation below.
data_description.tenant_devices: Optional. One device = all its entities.
data_description.confirm_sensitive: Remembered once checked. Without this box, saving is refused when the selection contains a camera, lock or alarm.
data_description.allow_remote: Off by default. The account is not local-only for the length of the stay. Home Assistant must already be reachable from outside; this integration opens nothing. Also turn this on to try the HA account over Tailscale (a 100.x address is not local).
data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty = persistent notification only. This goes to you, not the guest.
data_description.guest_mail_service: e.g. notify.smtp. Sends the welcome note to the guest (address read from the calendar description). Empty = copy the note by hand.
data_description.guest_mail_days: Send the welcome mail this many days before arrival. Default: 2. The Wi-Fi and door codes are already issued (J−3).
data_description.journal_path: Relative to the config folder, or absolute under config/ or a media folder (Synology share).
data_description.title_blocklist: Comma-separated substrings that are not guests (blocked dates).
data_description.print_event: When enabled, the cleartext code is published on usvegliu_print_voucher and may end up in traces. Leave off unless you print.
data_description.guest_base_url: Public origin, no path. e.g. https://www.usvegliu.fr — guest links become /s/<token>. Empty = Home Assistant internal URL.
data_description.guest_theme: U Svegliu (Corsica) or 49 Ledbury (Notting Hill). One HA instance, one theme.
data_description.guest_locale: French or English for the Maison app (copy, weather, welcome mail). Independent of the theme.
data_description.wifi_ssid: SSID shown under Informations. Empty = theme default.
data_description.house_mode_entity: Owner switch. On = cooling, off = heating. Guests can read it, they cannot toggle it.
data_description.outdoor_temperature: Shown in the corner of the climate page. Read-only.
data_description.pool_temperature: Shown on the Pool tab. Read-only.
data_description.alarm_code: Used server-side to arm/disarm. Never sent to the browser. Empty = keep the stored code.
data_description.voucher_provider: UniFi, Cambium API (X), or manual (pasted code, no API).
data_description.cambium_client_id: API application created in cnMaestro Cloud (Account → API).
data_description.cambium_client_secret: Application secret. Empty = keep the stored secret.
data_description.cambium_portal: Exact EasyPass portal name in cnMaestro.
data_description.cambium_voucher_plan: Exact voucher plan name (duration and devices are set in cnMaestro).
data_description.manual_wifi_code: EasyPass code shown in Maison/mail. Empty = keep the stored code.
data_description.enable_nuki: Per-stay Keypad PIN (mail, Infos, Console). Independent of unlocking the Nuki lock in Maison. Unchecked: the welcome mail still goes out without a door code.
data_description.nuki_token: Created at https://web.nuki.io (API). Empty = keep the stored token.
data_description.nuki_smartlock_id: Leave empty if there is only one lock. Otherwise the numeric Nuki id of the front door.
data_description.bulk_add_domains: After filtering: pick domains (e.g. light, climate) then Save to add them all. Remove unwanted chips afterward.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect the UDM
reconfigure.description: The new key replaces the previous one. It is not written to the log.

error.cannot_connect: The UDM did not respond. Check the address, the port, and that the Integration API is enabled (Network 9.1+, path /proxy/network/integration).
error.ssl_error: TLS certificate rejected. Disable verification for a self-signed certificate, on the local network only.
error.no_sites: No Network site, or the saved site no longer exists.
error.sensitive_entities: The selection contains a camera, lock or alarm. Check the confirmation to allow it, or remove those devices.
error.invalid_path: The journal file must stay inside the config directory or a media directory (mounted Synology share).
error.cambium_incomplete: With Cambium, fill in client ID, secret, EasyPass portal and voucher plan.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the log: the API key is not written there.

abort.already_configured: This controller and site are already configured.
abort.reconfigure_not_unifi: This entry is Cambium: change the client ID / secret in Options.
abort.wrong_account: The site does not match this entry.

dashboard_missing.title: Guest dashboard missing
dashboard_missing.description: The integration could not create the dashboard “{url_path}”. Create a storage dashboard with URL usvegliu-sejour (a hyphen is required), visible to non-admins, then call usvegliu.appliquer_tableau. Other dashboards (cameras, locks) should be admin-only.

owner_dashboard_missing.title: Owner console missing
owner_dashboard_missing.description: The console is not the Location or Stay dashboard. Settings → Dashboards → +, new empty dashboard. Title: Usvegliu propriétaire (Home Assistant then generates URL {url_path}). Do not mark it admin-only: Users with control rights must see it. Show in sidebar. Then Developer tools → Actions → usvegliu.appliquer_tableau. Open /{url_path} or the Console sidebar item.
